csv_project_name: DB for Eugene J. Towbin VA Security Adjudication Center
csv_scope_of_work: The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE), Little Rock District is seeking firm/contractor capabilities regarding a requirement for a turnkey Design-Build (DB) construction of a VA Personal Security Adjudication Center (PSAC) facility at the Eugene J. Towbin VA Healthcare Center campus in North Little Rock, AR. The size of the new facility will be approximately a minimum of 10,000 SF, two-story building with options to increase size. Building Options are for 12,000, 14,000, and a 16,000 SF building. New two-story building will be serving approximately 75 Full-Time Equivalents (FTEs) with a maximum capacity of 50 vehicles in a dedicated, gated parking lot, including accessible parking. The construction contract award is planned to be in FY26, with an estimated period of performance is 753 days from contract award. The key requirements of this project are as follows: a. Private supervisor offices b. Open work cubicles c. A Sensitive Compartmented Information Facility (SCIF), approximately 150 square feet d. Common administrative areas e. Dedicated mechanical, electrical, and IT/communications rooms f. General support spaces g. Equipment storage h. Required site work and utility connections i. Adequate horizontal and vertical circulation infrastructure, as needed j. Removal of existing tree k. Breakroom / Wet Bar l. Design and implementation of storm water and drainage management surrounding the new Facility. m. Option - covered breezeway with lighting and electric outlets connecting new building to existing building (no new entry in the existing building).
csv_disciplines_requested: Design Build/Developer, Interior Design/Space Planning, Landscape Architecture, Rehabilitation & Refurbishment, Cost Estimating
